m: दघ् cl. 5. (Pot. ˚घ्नुयात्; Prec. 3. sg. ˚घ्यास्; aor. Subj. 1. pl. ˚घ्म) with पश्चा, or ˚चात्, to fall short of (cf. अ-पस्चा-दघ्वन्), RV. i, 123, 5; vii, 56, 2; with अधस्, to reach below the regular height, Kāṭh. viii, 12; to strike, Dhātup. xxvii, 26; to protect (cf. √ दङ्घ्), ib. : cl. 4. दघ्यति, to go, Naigh. ii, 4; to flow, Nir. i, 9; cf. अति-, आ-; प्रदघस्; δέχομαι.
a: दघ् — {vI.v} {c5c} P. (दघ्नोति) 1 To kill, hurt. --2 To go, leap. --3 To protect. {vII.v} {c4c} P. (दघ्यति) Ved. 1 To go, flow. --2 To reach, attain. --3 To go away.

na GAtane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (svAMparaM-sakaM-sew .) na, daGnoti । daGa GAte । iti jOmarAH paWanti । tena tadarTakalpanamevocitam । tataSca GAtanamiti hantyarTasya pAkzikacurAditvena svArTe YO rUpaM hananamityarTaH । kiYca hiMsanapAWenEvezwasidDe GAtanapAWo hiMsApreraRArTaH syAnna veti kAkadantAnvezaRavadbiPalaM trayARAmeva kAtantrAdyasammatatvAt । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

m: दघ्न mf(आ, ई)n. ifc. (Pāṇ. iv, 1, 15; v, 2, 37), ‘reaching up to’, cf. अंस-, अश्व-, आ-, उप-कक्ष-, उपस्थ-, ऊरु-, कण्ठ-, कुल्फ-, गुल्फ-, जानु-, नाभि-, मुख-, स्तन-.
a: दघ्न — a. (घ्नी f.) A termination added to nouns in the sense of ‘reaching to’, ‘as high or deep as’; ऊरुदघ्नेन पयसोत्तीर्य K.; कीलालव्यतिकरगुल्फदघ्नपंकः (मार्गः) Māl. 3. 17; 5. 14, Y. 2. 108.
